description: Long Term Development Statement - Common Information Model (CIM) is a dataset listed in UK Power Networks open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity distribution network operator, published or maintained by UK Power Networks. Introduction The Long Term Development Statement (LTDS) in Common Information Model (CIM) provides standardised network data that enables interoperability between electricity network analysis tools. It provides a common data format to represent electrical network components and their relationships. This allows consistent data exchange across different software tools, such as PowerFactory and IPSA. Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal files it under Network Infrastructure. The portal shows 2026-06-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is UK Power Networks Shared Data Licence - Common Information Model (https://ukpowernetworks.sharepoint.com/:b:/s/OpenDataPortalLibrary/IQBOc_U7vx1GQqIOIMlkBAzhAW7sqW9vVvcm1twzb7lIy_Y?e=BG45N3). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ukpn-open-data-portal.
